product_metadata.title: 4 Pack Mini Loaf Pans, Non-Stick Baking Bread Pan, Carbon Steel Bakeware
features: COOK MORE - Set of 4 mini loaf pans, versatile for meatloaf, lasagna & casseroles, plus all kinds of delicious desserts.

FOOD SAFE MATERIAL - Heavy-weight carbon-steel construction provides durability and fast, even heating for uniform browning. Food safe nonstick coating ensures effortless food release; oven-safe to 450 degrees F.
PAN DIMENSIONS - 6 1/8 x 3 3/8 x 1 5/8 in. (15.6 x 8.6 x 4.2 cm).

GREAT VALUE - You only need to pay 1 but get 4 Pack mini loaf pans - ideal for mini loaves, individual brownies, mini sweet breads, mini pound cakes and more. Hand wash recommended. For best results, wash in warm, soapy water before first and after each use.

LIFETIME GUARANTEE - We are so confident in the quality of our mini loaf pan that we offer you a lifetime guarantee. Reach out to us if there’s ever anything you need; we are dedicated to your satisfaction.
